comparison_policy: randomized paired Guion/Python runs; every execution checks the fixed oracle; Guion baseline/candidate are paired together on final reruns

measurement.candidate_order: seeded randomized order within each paired trial
measurement.cache_policy: fresh source runs bypass Guion source cache; cached source and prebuilt artifact lanes are distinct; OS file cache is uncontrolled
measurement.timer: time.perf_counter around the child process from startup through exit; output is validated immediately afterward and excluded from the timed duration
measurement.memory: resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss for direct child process; process-pool worker peaks are separate and their sum is only an upper bound
measurement.heavy_runs: sequential; no concurrent build or benchmark

workloads.python_reference: same harness generates tiny.py with identical output
workloads.oracle: exact stdout on every timed run

workloads.input: deterministic generated JSONL; 20000 rows plus 200000-row scale point; seed 20261025
workloads.role: text and JSON processing plus real application workflow

workloads.source: evaluation/development/core_north_star_sprint/http_request_legacy.gu and the typed-response equivalent in http_response_json.gu
workloads.fixture: offline loopback 127.0.0.1, persistent local server, 65,579-byte JSON response, explicit exact host grant
workloads.request_count: one /json request per timed or warmup invocation; fixture count asserted against 17 per arm

excluded: optional Python bridge micro-optimization unless another selected outcome demonstrably depends on it
cold disk cache claims; storage cache cannot be reliably flushed in this environment
